examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Careers values band: a large, centred copy cell with no actions beside the turning brand globe. Edit the props in the Controls panel — give it one action and the whole band becomes a link, two and it stays unlinked.

examples.name: Product media
examples.summary: The band with a ProductWidget console screen as its picture (`widget`), then with a Diagram request flow (`diagram`). Both sit inset in the media cell, and the widget plays its beat while the pointer is over the band.
